description: The host's Claude and Codex subscription accounts (hostaccounts): list them; add one (Claude: name and token; Codex: name and an existing signed-in home); rename one (id, name); replace a Claude account's token (id, token); remove one (id); select a provider's default for new chats (provider, id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); read a subscription's usage (id; "" for the CLI's own sign-in); sign in to Codex with a device code (sign_in: name for a new account, or id to sign in to one again: its lines come as they're written, then its end; the connection's going stops it). Each is answered with accounts.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

id.description: rename, token, remove, select, usage, sign_in: the account ("" for the CLI's own sign-in, select and usage only).

name.description: add, rename, sign_in (a new account): its name.

token.description: add (Claude), token: a token from claude setup-token.

home.description: add (Codex): an existing CODEX_HOME on the host, signed in with ChatGPT and keeping its credentials in a file.
